PurgeResponse.description: At the end of their turn, if the <style="Faction_LeaguesOfVotann">Ironkin Steeljack</style> is adjacent to a friendly <style="Faction_LeaguesOfVotann">Leagues of Votann</style> <style="Character">character</style>, they start <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, even if they attacked in their turn. While <style="Buff_Overwatching">Overwatching</style>, the Ironkin Steeljack's attacks ignore hit reductions.
